source.name: tr_OrderAudit
source.sourceDefinition:
CREATE   TRIGGER dbo.tr_OrderAudit
ON dbo.Orders
AFTER INSERT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO dbo.OrderMetadata (OrderID, MetadataXml)
    SELECT i.OrderID, CAST('<audit><timestamp>' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), GETDATE(), 126) + '</timestamp></audit>' AS XML)
    FROM inserted i
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.OrderMetadata m WHERE m.OrderID = i.OrderID);
END;
